findings.claim: Task definition revision 42 of checkout-api differs from revision 41 only in the environment variable DB_HOST, which now names checkout-db.internal.example.com instead of the database endpoint.
A user named deployer updated the service checkout-api five minutes before the impact started.
findings.excerpt: UpdateService (ecs.amazonaws.com) by deployer on checkout-api, 5 minutes before the incident started
